series_start_reason: Symbicort was launched ex-U.S. in 2000-2001 (U.S. 2007). The earliest quarter that can be cited contiguously is 2001Q3: AstraZeneca's own 2001 and Q1/Q2 2002 results announcements are not on EDGAR (2002 6-Ks to Oct 2002 are paper filings) and the Q3 2002 release prints the nine-month 2001 figure (34) but only Q3 2001 (20) individually, so Q1/Q2 2001 are not separable. 2001Q3, 2001Q4, 2002Q1 and 2002Q2 are read from the prior-year columns of the Q3 2002, Q4 2002, Q1 2003 and Q2 2003 releases (derivation direct_prior_year_column); 2002Q3 onward from each quarter's own release.
notes: Worldwide Symbicort product sales as totalled by AstraZeneca (U.S. included from its 2007 launch). FDA approval 21 Jul 2006. Launch quarter not stated by quarter in any cited issuer document.
